name: TITLE SHAPES
_comment: A composite submissions payload: one row per title shape the live feed produces, taken verbatim from several filers, because no single filer files both an 8-K and a 6-K. The form, items and primaryDocDescription of each row are as data.sec.gov returned them on 2026-08-03. Rows 1-4 are AMGN and LLY 8-Ks: items always populated, primaryDocDescription always the form's own name. Rows 5-7 are SNY, BNTX and ARGX 6-Ks, which carry no items at all because the item taxonomy belongs to the domestic forms; the first two describe them '6-K' and 'FORM 6-K', ARGX writes the announcement. The cik is SNY's, since the URL builder needs one and the parser does not read it per row.
